newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DSM may sue Mitsui over fibre patents.
newsitem.headline: DSM may sue Mitsui over fibre patents.

text.p: Dutch chemicals and plastics maker DSM is considering lodging a multimillion-guilder claim against Japan's Mitsui for violation of patents, a company spokesman said.
"It has not been officially decided yet," said DSM spokesman Arthur Spierts at the weekend, but added that if the claim did go ahead, it would "definitely be in the millions of guilders range".
At a Japanese court hearing two weeks ago, Mitsui attempted to have declared void patents granted to DSM for the raw material for the production of high grade fibres.
But the court declared DSM the rightful patent owner and ordered Mitsui to stop production of the material concerned.
Spierts said if DSM did decide to pursue the case against Mitsui, it would primarily be over damages for loss of revenues.
High grade fibres are one of the fastest growing sectors in the elastomers market, expanding by around 20 percent a year.
